title: TrashFix
description: 8 balanced recycling recipes to turn trash items like rotten flesh and poisonous potatoes into useful resources. Lightweight, server-side, vanilla-friendly.
body:
*Trahfix :

Trahfix is a lightweight, server-side mod that adds 8 balanced recycling recipes to Minecraft. Clean up your inventory and make use of the “junk” items you usually throw away, without breaking vanilla balance or adding new machines.

### *What is TrashFix 

Instead of cluttering your chests with useless items, Trahfix gives them a second life through simple crafting recipes. Everything works in the vanilla crafting table. No blocks, no GUIs, no tech trees.

*Added Recipes:*
1. *Rotten Flesh x4 → Leather*
![Crafting recipe: 4 Rotten Flesh to 1 Leather in Minecraft Trahfix mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b0cc4ee3c8726194c7f9e2fb7ef5613e0267eb1_0.webp)
2. *Poisonous Potato → Bone Meal*
![Crafting recipe: 1 Poisonous Potato to 1 Bone Meal in Minecraft Trahfix mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87236e7df9df484ac8eebb421734f167a7676795_0.webp)
3. *String x9 → Cobweb*
![Crafting recipe: 9 String to 1 Cobweb in Minecraft Trahfix mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bca4f4e873e88e92e080c9a22f974c9df65badc9_0.webp)
4. *Bone Meal x4→ Bone *
![Crafting recipe: 4 Bone Meal to 1 Bone in Minecraft Trahfix mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f95dc734e2459950d01443b41aae4dd316b5cf7_0.webp)
5. *Flint x4↔ Gravel x2*
![Crafting recipe: 4 Flint to 2 Gravel in Minecraft Trahfix mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d50be1869ac1b2d34fa4f0b4f7495deb3a2defd6_0.webp)
6. *Andesite x4 → Cobblestone x4*
![Crafting recipe: 4 Andesite to 4 Cobblestone in Minecraft Trahfix mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5850537c7a30e3dc0713ccb7d35dd5370214f21d_0.webp)
7. *Dead Bush x4→ Bone Meal x4*
![Crafting recipe: 4 Dead Bushes to 4 Bone Meal in Minecraft Trahfix mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e77cc08d514d61a7496c1a607ea817dbc82969af_0.webp)
8.*Gravel x4 → Flint x2 
![Crafting recipe: 4 Gravel to 2 Flint in Minecraft Trahfix mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/50f6d3b9218fdafb424fbcce06d5aa67261a8355_0.webp)


*100% Balanced*  
Every recipe follows vanilla value ratios. Nothing is overpowered. You trade time and materials fairly, just like in base Minecraft.
*Server-Side Only*  
Install it on your server and everyone benefits. Players don’t need to install the mod client-side. Perfect for public servers and modpacks.
*Ultra Lightweight*  
Under 150KB. Zero impact on performance, load time, or RAM usage.
*Vanilla+ Friendly*  
Designed for survival and vanilla+ modpacks that want small quality-of-life improvements without changing the core game feel.
*Safe to Add/Remove*  
Trahfix doesn’t modify world generation or existing blocks. You can add it to an existing world or remove it anytime without corruption.
### *Compatibility*
- *Minecraft:* 1.21.1, 1.21.8
- *Loader:* Neoforge , Fabric 
### *Notes for Modpack Creators*
Trahfix is open for inclusion in modpacks. No permissions needed.
